d: Wavy, long champagne-blonde hair with a bold red streak on the left side and blue highlights on the right, featuring long bangs swept to the side. Bright sky-blue eyes with a cheerful, gentle expression on a youthful, adolescent face. A slender build wearing a white military-style jacket with gold buttons and a gold buckle belt, paired with a navy blue skirt and a red, white, and blue plaid capelet draped over one shoulder. Accessories include a large white beret with a red pompom and a blue ribbon tied beneath it.
